notes.title: Cloud Jumper Store Page Updates
notes.content:
[h2]Hey friends!👋[/h2]

[h3]Notice anything new around here? 👀[/h3]
Our team have been working hard on developing Cloud Jumper behind the scenes but we're finally ready to start sharing that journey with you! 

[h3]You might have seen some updates to our store page...⛅[/h3]
We've updated our steam page to better represent the direction that development for Cloud Jumper has taken us in. Have a look around and check out the brand new artwork! ✨

[h3]Keep up to date with development progress! ☁[/h3]
We also have a shiny new [strike]Twitter[/strike] [i][b]X[/b][/i] account for you to follow and get a behind the scenes preview of the work that goes in to creating the game. [url=https://x.com/cloudjumpergame]Check out the most recent updates here![/url]

We can't wait to keep sharing our progress with you and the details of the game Cloud Jumper is becoming, and we hope you're excited to come along for the adventure too 💛
Be in touch soon with some more exciting updates!

- Melissa, Social Media and Community Coordinator
